name: world-writable-dir
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: loosens a directory's mode (e.g. a PATH bin dir to 0777, or clears the sticky bit from a world-writable dir). Vars: DIR (required); MODE (optional, default 0777).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${DIR:?DIR is required}"
mode="${MODE:-0777}"
[ -d "$DIR" ] || install -d "$DIR"
chmod "$mode" "$DIR"
